title: Unit Event — With Our Wounded Hands — Episode6 Fear

meta.Event Outline: Ena hasn't been able to reach Mizuki since the school festival. She doesn't know what the right thing to do is, but her regrets compel her to seek Mizuki out for a heart-to-heart.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I still couldn't really get my head around it...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I don't have the courage to just disappear either.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And yet, I don't see the point in living.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Which is why watching anime like this works, because...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't have to think about anything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wonder if Ena's still trying to get a hold of me.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I've been logged out of Nightcord ever since that day, so I really don't know.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What happened to keeping your distance from us...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Are you not coming back to SEKAI?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We've been to all the usual places we could come up with, but it is possible that we keep just missing each other...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How do you know that Mizuki's left home at all...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's all we can do right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If only we could reach Mizuki's phone somehow.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: B-But you said you always ended up somewhere pitch black whenever you tried going over to Mizuki's phone...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I managed to pop in when it was actually in use.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And we had a chance to talk a little.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, where's Mizuki been all this time?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: For a few days at the very least...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Supplementary classes. Although, I'm not sure Mizuki's actually going to show up for them...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I happened to run into Aoyagi during my search.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Based on my conversation with him, Mizuki's missed enough days to have to attend supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I remember hearing something about having to attend supplementary classes or risk being held back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Considering how Mizuki's just barely been staying in contact with Shiraishi...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm guessing it has something to do with not wanting others to worry.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki's worried that getting held back would cause trouble for everyone?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's true that Mizuki might be feeling that way, and it would explain those messages with Shiraishi. Still...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is Mizuki really going to show up...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, I have to take whatever I can at this point...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks, Mafuyu.
I'll try asking the teachers about those supplementary classes!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm really sorry, but would you keep being by Mizuki's side if possible?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I've got things covered here.
Thanks again for coming.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But still no sign...
Mizuki seems to come here just after noon, so we can probably expect to keep waiting until the last minute.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Voice
rows.Line: <Okay. In that case, I'll stay near the school gate a little while longer.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you skip school like this, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Voice
rows.Line: <It's okay. This is far more important.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll let you know if something happens.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Today's when the teachers said there'd be supplementary classes...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've been looking all over for Mizuki since then, but we never once saw each other.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still, today might be my biggest chance...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Those supplementary classes are supposed to take place after school, so Mizuki should, in theory, be arriving soon.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If I'm going to maximize my odds, should I wait by the main entrance instead of by this classroom?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't know, but I'd rather not miss my chance by moving around needlessly.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But this is basically my last shot.
I have to bet everything on it.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But is this really what I'm supposed to be doing...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Sorry, you two.
I have a huge favor to ask...!>
